description_en: A standalone triangular woven pouch with textile zip gusset and three leather attachment straps, no bicycle. Canonical front: a triangular woven face with three strap tabs. Side view: a narrow zipper gusset and attachment-loop thickness. Rear view: a second triangular woven face with padded frame-contact strips. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
